title: Hybrid Recursive Ladder: Query Planning for Bucket-Limited Time-Series APIs
description:
A query-planning method for long-range time-series aggregation over APIs with a hard per-request bucket limit. The range is decomposed into complete calendar units; each maximal contiguous run sharing a fetch level is fetched once at the next finer aggregation and folded locally; optional coverage tracking fetches only uncovered sub-ranges.

This release is a public disclosure of the method and its formal properties. It is a composition of calendar mixed-radix decomposition, canonical interval decomposition, roll-up and multi-resolution aggregation. The code is released under the MIT License.
notes: Public disclosure / prior art for the Hybrid Recursive Ladder query-planning method.
